# api_engines/orcarouter.py
"""
OrcaRouter 多模态引擎 - OpenAI 兼容的 AI 网关
支持：Chat 对话、图像生成、文本转语音、视频生成、Seedance 资产管理
文档：https://docs.orcarouter.ai/
"""

import os
import requests
import io
import json
import time
import base64
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, List, Union, Generator
from enum import Enum


class OrcaRouterMode(Enum):
    """OrcaRouter 支持的模式"""
    CHAT = "chat"
    IMAGE = "image"
    TTS = "tts"
    VIDEO = "video"


class OrcaRouterEngine:
    """
    OrcaRouter 多模态引擎
    
    OrcaRouter 是一个 OpenAI 兼容的 AI 网关，统一访问 200+ 模型：
    - OpenAI (GPT-5.2, GPT-4o, GPT-5.4, DALL-E 3, GPT-Image-1)
    - Anthropic (Claude Opus 5, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5)
    - Google Gemini (Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash)
    - DeepSeek (DeepSeek V4, R1)
    - xAI Grok (Grok-3, Grok-4)
    - 阿里巴巴 Qwen (Qwen3.7 Max)
    - Moonshot Kimi (Kimi k2.5)
    - MiniMax (M2.5, H3 视频)
    - Z.ai (GLM-5)
    - Kling (快手视频)
    - ByteDance Seedance (视频)
    """
    
    # ✅ 默认模型配置（支持 provider/model 命名空间）
    DEFAULT_MODELS = {
        # Chat / 推理模型
        "chat": "openai/gpt-4o-mini",
        "vision": "openai/gpt-4o",
        "reasoning": "anthropic/claude-opus-4.6",
        "coding": "deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash",
        
        # 图像生成模型
        "image": "openai/gpt-image-1",
        
        # 文本转语音模型
        "tts": "openai/tts-1",
        
        # 视频生成模型
        "video_kling": "kling/kling-v3-omni",
        "video_seedance": "byteplus/dreamina-seedance-2-0-260128",
        "video_minimax": "minimax/minimax-h3",
    }
    
    # ✅ 支持的提供商前缀
    PROVIDERS = {
        "openai": "OpenAI",
        "anthropic": "Anthropic",
        "google": "Google",
        "deepseek": "DeepSeek",
        "grok": "xAI",
        "qwen": "Alibaba Qwen",
        "kimi": "Moonshot Kimi",
        "minimax": "MiniMax",
        "z-ai": "Z.ai",
        "kling": "Kling (快手)",
        "byteplus": "ByteDance Seedance",
    }
    
    # ✅ 官方服务路由
    ROUTES = [
        "https://api.orcarouter.ai/v1",
    ]
    
    # ✅ 支持的 TTS 音频格式
    SUPPORTED_TTS_FORMATS = ["mp3", "opus", "aac", "flac", "wav", "pcm"]
    
    # ✅ 支持的图像尺寸档位
    IMAGE_SIZES = ["256x256", "512x512", "1024x1024", "1024x1792", "1792x1024"]
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        api_key: str,
        base_url: str = None,
        model: str = None,
        chat_model: str = None,
        image_model: str = None,
        tts_model: str = None,
        video_model: str = None,
        vision_model: str = None,
        reasoning_model: str = None,
        coding_model: str = None,
    ):
        """
        初始化 OrcaRouter 引擎
        
        Args:
            api_key: OrcaRouter API Key (以 sk-orca- 开头)
            base_url: API 地址（默认使用 OrcaRouter 官方地址）
            model: 默认模型
            chat_model: 聊天/推理模型
            image_model: 图像生成模型
            tts_model: 文本转语音模型
            video_model: 视频生成模型
            vision_model: 视觉理解模型
            reasoning_model: 深度推理模型
            coding_model: 代码专用模型
        """
        self.api_key = api_key
        
        # ✅ 设置基础 URL
        if base_url:
            self.base_url = base_url.rstrip('/')
        else:
            self.base_url = self.ROUTES[0]
        
        self._current_route_index = 0
        self._failed_routes = set()
        
        # 各能力模型配置
        self.chat_model = chat_model or model or self.DEFAULT_MODELS["chat"]
        self.image_model = image_model or self.DEFAULT_MODELS["image"]
        self.tts_model = tts_model or self.DEFAULT_MODELS["tts"]
        self.video_model = video_model or self.DEFAULT_MODELS["video_kling"]
        self.vision_model = vision_model or model or self.DEFAULT_MODELS["vision"]
        self.reasoning_model = reasoning_model or self.DEFAULT_MODELS["reasoning"]
        self.coding_model = coding_model or self.DEFAULT_MODELS["coding"]
        
        # 限速
        self.last_request_time = 0
        self.min_interval = 0.5
        
        # 重试配置
        self.max_retries = 3
        self.retry_delay = 2
        
        if not self.api_key:
            print("⚠️ 未设置 ORCAROUTER_API_KEY，请从 https://www.orcarouter.ai/ 注册获取")
        
        print(f"🔍 OrcaRouter 引擎初始化")
        print(f"🔍 API 地址: {self.base_url}")
        print(f"🔍 聊天模型: {self.chat_model}")
        print(f"🔍 图像模型: {self.image_model}")
        print(f"🔍 语音模型: {self.tts_model}")
        print(f"🔍 视频模型: {self.video_model}")
    
    # ==================== 核心请求方法 ====================
    
    def _get_working_route(self) -> str:
        """获取可用的路由"""
        if self._current_route_index < len(self.ROUTES):
            route = self.ROUTES[self._current_route_index]
            if route not in self._failed_routes:
                return route
        
        for i, route in enumerate(self.ROUTES):
            if route not in self._failed_routes:
                self._current_route_index = i
                self.base_url = route
                print(f"🔄 切换到备用路由: {route}")
                return route
        
        print("⚠️ 所有路由均不可用，重置路由列表...")
        self._failed_routes.clear()
        self._current_route_index = 0
        self.base_url = self.ROUTES[0]
        return self.ROUTES[0]
    
    def _mark_route_failed(self, route: str):
        """标记路由为失败"""
        self._failed_routes.add(route)
        print(f"⚠️ 路由 {route} 已标记为不可用")
    
    def _request(
        self,
        endpoint: str,
        data: Dict[str, Any],
        timeout: int = 120,
        stream: bool = False,
    ) -> Union[Dict[str, Any], requests.Response]:
        """发送请求到 OrcaRouter API（带路由切换和重试）"""
        if not self.api_key:
            raise ValueError("请设置 ORCAROUTER_API_KEY")
        
        elapsed = time.time() - self.last_request_time
        if elapsed < self.min_interval:
            time.sleep(self.min_interval - elapsed)
        
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        
        max_attempts = len(self.ROUTES) * 2
        for attempt in range(max_attempts):
            route = self._get_working_route()
            url = f"{route}/{endpoint.lstrip('/')}"
            
            try:
                if stream:
                    response = requests.post(
                        url,
                        headers=headers,
                        json=data,
                        stream=True,
                        timeout=timeout
                    )
                    self.last_request_time = time.time()
                    return response
                
                response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=data, timeout=timeout)
                self.last_request_time = time.time()
                
                if response.status_code == 503:
                    print(f"⚠️ 路由 {route} 返回 503，尝试切换...")
                    self._mark_route_failed(route)
                    time.sleep(1)
                    continue
                
                if response.status_code == 429:
                    print(f"⚠️ 请求限流 (429)，等待后重试...")
                    time.sleep(3)
                    continue
                
                if response.status_code != 200:
                    error_detail = {}
                    try:
                        error_detail = response.json()
                    except:
                        pass
                    
                    if error_detail:
                        error_msg = error_detail.get('error', {}).get('message', str(error_detail))
                    else:
                        error_msg = response.text[:200]
                    
                    raise Exception(f"OrcaRouter API 调用失败 (状态码 {response.status_code}): {error_msg}")
                
                return response.json()
                
            except requests.exceptions.ConnectionError:
                print(f"⚠️ 路由 {route} 连接失败，尝试切换...")
                self._mark_route_failed(route)
                time.sleep(1)
                continue
            except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
                print(f"⚠️ 路由 {route} 超时，尝试切换...")
                self._mark_route_failed(route)
                time.sleep(1)
                continue
            except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
                if attempt == max_attempts - 1:
                    raise Exception(f"OrcaRouter 请求失败: {e}")
                print(f"⚠️ 请求异常 (尝试 {attempt+1}/{max_attempts}): {e}")
                time.sleep(2)
                continue
        
        raise Exception("OrcaRouter 所有路由均不可用，请稍后重试")
    
    def _download_image(self, image_url: str) -> bytes:
        """下载图片"""
        img_response = requests.get(image_url, timeout=30)
        if img_response.status_code != 200:
            raise Exception(f"下载图片失败: {img_response.status_code}")
        return img_response.content
    
    # ==================== 1. Chat / 对话 ====================
    
    def chat(
        self,
        messages: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        model: str = None,
        temperature: float = 0.7,
        max_tokens: int = 4096,
        stream: bool = False,
        tools: List[Dict] = None,
        tool_choice: Union[str, Dict] = None,
        response_format: Dict = None,
        extra_body: Dict = None,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Chat 对话/推理
        
        Args:
            messages: 消息列表 [{"role": "user", "content": "..."}]
            model: 模型名称（默认使用 chat_model）
            temperature: 温度参数
            max_tokens: 最大 token 数
            stream: 是否流式输出
            tools: 工具列表 [{"type": "function", "function": {...}}]
            tool_choice: 工具选择策略 ("auto", "none", "required" 或具体工具名)
            response_format: 结构化输出格式 {"type": "json_object"}
            extra_body: 额外参数（如 extra_body={"models": [...]} 用于 fallback chain）
        
        Returns:
            模型响应文本（非流式）或生成器（流式）
        """
        model = model or self.chat_model
        
        data = {
            "model": model,
            "messages": messages,
            "temperature": temperature,
            "max_tokens": max_tokens,
            "stream": stream,
        }
        
        if tools:
            data["tools"] = tools
        
        if tool_choice:
            data["tool_choice"] = tool_choice
        
        if response_format:
            data["response_format"] = response_format
        
        if extra_body:
            data.update(extra_body)
        
        print(f"🔍 OrcaRouter Chat")
        print(f"🔍 模型: {model}, 消息数: {len(messages)}")
        if tools:
            print(f"🔍 工具数量: {len(tools)}")
        
        if stream:
            response = self._request("chat/completions", data, stream=True)
            return self._parse_stream(response)
        
        result = self._request("chat/completions", data)
        
        if 'choices' in result and result['choices']:
            choice = result['choices'][0]
            message = choice.get('message', {})
            
            # 处理工具调用
            if message.get('tool_calls'):
                return message
            
            return message.get('content', '')
        
        raise Exception(f"无法解析推理结果: {json.dumps(result)[:300]}")
    
    def _parse_stream(self, response) -> str:
        """解析流式响应"""
        result_text = ""
        for line in response.iter_lines():
            if line:
                line = line.decode('utf-8')
                if line.startswith('data: '):
                    line = line[6:]
                    if line == '[DONE]':
                        break
                    try:
                        chunk = json.loads(line)
                        if 'choices' in chunk and chunk['choices']:
                            delta = chunk['choices'][0].get('delta', {})
                            content = delta.get('content', '')
                            if content:
                                print(content, end='', flush=True)
                                result_text += content
                    except:
                        pass
        print()
        return result_text
    
    def chat_simple(self, prompt: str, system_prompt: str = None, model: str = None, **kwargs) -> str:
        """简化版 Chat 对话"""
        messages = []
        if system_prompt:
            messages.append({"role": "system", "content": system_prompt})
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})
        return self.chat(messages, model=model, **kwargs)
    
    def chat_vision(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        image_bytes: bytes = None,
        image_url: str = None,
        model: str = None,
        **kwargs
    ) -> str:
        """
        视觉理解对话（支持图片输入）
        
        Args:
            prompt: 文本提示词
            image_bytes: 图片二进制数据
            image_url: 图片 URL（公网可访问）
            model: 模型名称（建议使用 vision_model）
        """
        model = model or self.vision_model
        
        content_parts = [{"type": "text", "text": prompt}]
        
        if image_bytes:
            base64_image = base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode('utf-8')
            content_parts.append({
                "type": "image_url",
                "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/png;base64,{base64_image}"}
            })
        elif image_url:
            content_parts.append({"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": image_url}})
        
        messages = [{"role": "user", "content": content_parts}]
        return self.chat(messages, model=model, **kwargs)
    
    def chat_tool_call(
        self,
        messages: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        tools: List[Dict],
        model: str = None,
        tool_choice: str = "auto",
        **kwargs
    ) -> Dict:
        """
        执行工具调用
        
        Args:
            messages: 历史消息列表
            tools: 工具定义列表
            model: 模型名称
            tool_choice: 工具选择策略
        
        Returns:
            包含 tool_calls 的消息对象
        """
        model = model or self.chat_model
        
        return self.chat(
            messages=messages,
            model=model,
            tools=tools,
            tool_choice=tool_choice,
            stream=False,
            **kwargs
        )
    
    # ==================== 2. 图像生成 ====================
    
    def generate_image(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str = None,
        size: str = "1024x1024",
        n: int = 1,
        quality: str = "standard",
        style: str = "vivid",
        response_format: str = "url",
    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        图像生成
        
        支持的模型：
        - openai/gpt-image-1 (多模态，支持编辑)
        - openai/dall-e-3 (高质量静态图)
        - google/imagen-4.0-standard-generate-001
        - xai/grok-imagine-image
        
        Args:
            prompt: 图像描述提示词
            model: 图像生成模型
            size: 图像尺寸
            n: 生成数量
            quality: 质量档位（standard/hd）
            style: 风格（vivid/natural）
            response_format: 返回格式（url/base64）
        
        Returns:
            [{"url": "...", "revised_prompt": "..."}, ...]
        """
        model = model or self.image_model
        
        data = {
            "model": model,
            "prompt": prompt,
            "n": n,
            "size": size,
            "response_format": response_format,
        }
        
        if quality:
            data["quality"] = quality
        if style:
            data["style"] = style
        
        print(f"🔍 OrcaRouter 图像生成")
        print(f"🔍 模型: {model}, 尺寸: {size}, 数量: {n}")
        
        result = self._request("images/generations", data)
        
        images = []
        if 'data' in result:
            for item in result['data']:
                images.append({
                    "url": item.get('url'),
                    "revised_prompt": item.get('revised_prompt'),
                    "base64": item.get('b64_json'),
                })
        
        if not images:
            raise Exception(f"无法解析图片结果，响应: {json.dumps(result)[:300]}")
        
        return images
    
    def generate_image_with_download(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str = None,
        size: str = "1024x1024",
        n: int = 1,
    ) -> List[bytes]:
        """图像生成并下载"""
        images_data = self.generate_image(prompt, model=model, size=size, n=n)
        return [img.get('base64', '').encode() or self._download_image(img.get('url', '')) 
                for img in images_data if img]
    
    # ==================== 3. 文本转语音 ====================
    
    def text_to_speech(
        self,
        input_text: str,
        model: str = None,
        voice: str = "alloy",
        speed: float = 1.0,
        output_format: str = "mp3",
    ) -> bytes:
        """
        文本转语音
        
        Args:
            input_text: 要转换为语音的文本
            model: 语音合成模型（如 openai/tts-1, openai/tts-1-hd）
            voice: 声音类型（alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer）
            speed: 语速（0.25 - 4.0）
            output_format: 输出格式（mp3, opus, aac, flac, wav, pcm）
        
        Returns:
            音频字节数据
        """
        if output_format not in self.SUPPORTED_TTS_FORMATS:
            raise ValueError(f"不支持的输出格式: {output_format}，可选: {self.SUPPORTED_TTS_FORMATS}")
        
        model = model or self.tts_model
        
        data = {
            "model": model,
            "input": input_text,
            "voice": voice,
            "speed": speed,
            "response_format": output_format,
        }
        
        print(f"🔍 OrcaRouter 文本转语音")
        print(f"🔍 模型: {model}, 声音: {voice}, 语速: {speed}")
        
        result = self._request("audio/speech", data)
        
        # 处理不同类型的响应
        if isinstance(result, dict) and 'audio' in result:
            return result['audio']
        elif isinstance(result, str):
            return base64.b64decode(result)
        elif hasattr(result, 'content'):
            return result.content
        elif hasattr(result, 'body'):
            return result.body.read()
        
        raise Exception(f"无法解析语音结果: {str(result)[:200]}")
    
    def save_tts(
        self,
        input_text: str,
        filepath: str,
        model: str = None,
        voice: str = "alloy",
        speed: float = 1.0,
        output_format: str = "mp3",
    ) -> str:
        """文本转语音并保存到文件"""
        audio_data = self.text_to_speech(input_text, model, voice, speed, output_format)
        
        with open(filepath, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(audio_data)
        
        print(f"✅ 语音已保存至: {filepath}")
        return filepath
    
    # ==================== 4. 视频生成 ====================
    
    def video_generation(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str = None,
        image: bytes = None,
        image_url: str = None,
        duration: int = 5,
        aspect_ratio: str = "16:9",
        resolution: str = "720p",
        mode: str = "text-to-video",
        callback_url: str = None,
        # Kling 特有参数
        sound: str = None,
        multi_shot: bool = False,
        # Seedance 特有参数
        content: List[Dict] = None,
        generate_audio: bool = True,
        watermark: bool = False,
        seed: int = None,
        service_tier: str = None,
        return_last_frame: bool = False,
        # MiniMax 特有参数
        first_frame_image: bytes = None,
        last_frame_image: bytes = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        视频生成（异步）
        
        支持的模型：
        - kling/kling-v3-omni (Omni 多镜头)
        - kling/kling-v2-6 (运动+音频控制)
        - byteplus/dreamina-seedance-2-0-260128 (多模态参考)
        - minimax/minimax-h3 (原生立体音频)
        
        Args:
            prompt: 视频描述提示词
            model: 视频生成模型
            image: 参考图片字节数据（图生视频）
            image_url: 参考图片 URL
            duration: 视频时长（秒）
            aspect_ratio: 宽高比（16:9, 9:16, 1:1）
            resolution: 分辨率（720p, 1080p）
            mode: 生成模式（text-to-video, image-to-video, multi-shot）
            callback_url: 回调 URL
            sound: 音频描述（Kling）
            multi_shot: 是否多镜头（Kling）
            content: 内容数组（Seedance）
            generate_audio: 是否生成音频（Seedance）
            watermark: 是否添加水印（Seedance）
            seed: 随机种子（Seedance）
            service_tier: 服务等级（Seedance）
            return_last_frame: 是否返回末帧（Seedance）
            first_frame_image: 首帧图片（MiniMax）
            last_frame_image: 末帧图片（MiniMax）
        
        Returns:
            包含 task_id 的任务信息
        """
        # 确定模型前缀
        if model:
            prefix = model.split('/')[0] if '/' in model else "kling"
        elif 'kling' in self.video_model:
            prefix = "kling"
        elif 'byteplus' in self.video_model or 'seedance' in self.video_model:
            prefix = "byteplus"
        elif 'minimax' in self.video_model:
            prefix = "minimax"
        else:
            prefix = "kling"
        
        model = model or self.video_model
        
        data: Dict[str, Any] = {"model": model, "prompt": prompt}
        
        if prefix == "kling":
            data.update(self._build_kling_request(
                image=image, image_url=image_url, duration=duration,
                aspect_ratio=aspect_ratio, resolution=resolution,
                mode=mode, sound=sound, multi_shot=multi_shot, callback_url=callback_url,
            ))
        elif prefix == "byteplus":
            data.update(self._build_seedance_request(
                prompt=prompt, image=image, image_url=image_url,
                duration=duration, aspect_ratio=aspect_ratio, resolution=resolution,
                mode=mode, content=content, generate_audio=generate_audio,
                watermark=watermark, seed=seed, service_tier=service_tier,
                return_last_frame=return_last_frame, callback_url=callback_url,
            ))
        elif prefix == "minimax":
            data.update(self._build_minimax_request(
                prompt=prompt, image=image, image_url=image_url,
                duration=duration, aspect_ratio=aspect_ratio, resolution=resolution,
                first_frame_image=first_frame_image, last_frame_image=last_frame_image,
                callback_url=callback_url,
            ))
        
        print(f"🔍 OrcaRouter 视频生成")
        print(f"🔍 模型: {model}, Provider: {prefix}")
        print(f"🔍 模式: {mode}, 时长: {duration}s")
        
        result = self._request("video/generations", data, timeout=300)
        return result
    
    def _build_kling_request(
        self, image=None, image_url=None, duration=5, aspect_ratio="16:9",
        resolution="720p", mode="text-to-video", sound=None, multi_shot=False, callback_url=None
    ) -> Dict:
        """构建 Kling 视频请求体"""
        data = {"metadata": {}}
        
        data["metadata"].update({
            "mode": mode,
            "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio,
            "duration": duration,
            "resolution": resolution,
        })
        
        if image or image_url:
            if image_url:
                data["image"] = image_url
            elif image:
                data["image"] = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(image).decode('utf-8')}"
        
        if sound:
            data["metadata"]["sound"] = sound
        if multi_shot:
            data["metadata"]["multi_shot"] = multi_shot
        if callback_url:
            data["metadata"]["callback_url"] = callback_url
        
        return data
    
    def _build_seedance_request(
        self, prompt="", image=None, image_url=None, duration=5, aspect_ratio="16:9",
        resolution="720p", mode="text-to-video", content=None, generate_audio=True,
        watermark=False, seed=None, service_tier=None, return_last_frame=False, callback_url=None
    ) -> Dict:
        """构建 Seedance 视频请求体"""
        data = {"prompt": prompt, "metadata": {}}
        
        if content is None:
            content = [{"type": "text", "text": prompt}]
        
        data["metadata"]["content"] = content
        data["metadata"]["ratio"] = aspect_ratio
        data["metadata"]["duration"] = duration
        data["metadata"]["generate_audio"] = generate_audio
        data["metadata"]["watermark"] = watermark
        data["metadata"]["return_last_frame"] = return_last_frame
        data["metadata"]["resolution"] = resolution
        
        if seed is not None:
            data["metadata"]["seed"] = seed
        if service_tier:
            data["metadata"]["service_tier"] = service_tier
        if callback_url:
            data["metadata"]["callback_url"] = callback_url
        
        return data
    
    def _build_minimax_request(
        self, prompt="", image=None, image_url=None, duration=5, aspect_ratio="16:9",
        resolution="720p", first_frame_image=None, last_frame_image=None, callback_url=None
    ) -> Dict:
        """构建 MiniMax 视频请求体"""
        data = {
            "prompt": prompt,
            "duration": duration,
            "size": resolution,
        }
        
        if image or image_url:
            if image_url:
                data["image"] = image_url
            else:
                data["images"] = [f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(image).decode('utf-8')}"]
        
        if first_frame_image:
            data["metadata"] = {"first_frame_image": f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(first_frame_image).decode('utf-8')}"}
        if last_frame_image:
            if "metadata" not in data:
                data["metadata"] = {}
            data["metadata"]["last_frame_image"] = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(last_frame_image).decode('utf-8')}"
        if callback_url:
            data["callback_url"] = callback_url
        
        return data
    
    def video_status(self, video_id: str, model: str = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """查询视频生成状态"""
        model = model or self.video_model
        
        url = f"{self.base_url}/video/generations/{video_id}"
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        
        max_retries = 6
        wait = 15
        for attempt in range(max_retries):
            response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=30)
            
            if response.status_code == 200:
                return response.json()
            
            if response.status_code == 429:
                print(f"⚠️ 状态查询被限流 (429)，{wait}s 后重试...")
                time.sleep(wait)
                wait = min(wait * 2, 90)
                continue
            
            raise Exception(f"查询视频状态失败 (HTTP {response.status_code}): {response.text[:200]}")
        
        raise Exception(f"状态查询连续 {max_retries} 次被限流，放弃")
    
    def wait_for_video(
        self,
        video_id: str,
        max_wait: int = 600,
        poll_interval: int = 10,
        model: str = None,
    ) -> str:
        """等待视频生成完成"""
        start_time = time.time()
        consecutive_fail = 0
        backoff = 15
        
        while time.time() - start_time < max_wait:
            try:
                status = self.video_status(video_id, model=model)
                consecutive_fail = 0
                backoff = 15
            except Exception as e:
                consecutive_fail += 1
                print(f"⚠️ 状态查询失败 ({consecutive_fail}): {str(e)[:120]}")
                if consecutive_fail >= 5:
                    raise Exception(f"状态查询连续失败 {consecutive_fail} 次，放弃")
                time.sleep(backoff)
                backoff = min(backoff * 2, 60)
                continue
            
            state = status.get('status', '')
            progress = status.get('progress', 0)
            print(f"📊 状态: {state}, 进度: {progress}%")
            
            if state == 'completed':
                url = status.get('video_url', status.get('url', ''))
                if url:
                    return url
                time.sleep(poll_interval)
                continue
            
            if state in ('failed', 'error'):
                error = status.get('error', '未知错误')
                raise Exception(f"视频生成失败: {error}")
            
            if progress and progress >= 90:
                time.sleep(max(5, poll_interval // 2))
            else:
                time.sleep(poll_interval)
        
        raise Exception(f"视频生成超时 ({max_wait}s)")
    
    # ==================== 5. Seedance 资产管理 ====================
    
    def list_asset_groups(
        self,
        group_type: str = "real_human",
        page_size: int = 20,
        cursor: str = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        列出 Seedance 资产组
        
        Args:
            group_type: 资产类型（real_human, virtual_human, product, outfit, face, voice）
            page_size: 每页数量
            cursor: 分页游标
        
        Returns:
            资产组列表及分页信息
        """
        url = f"{self.base_url}/asset/groups"
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        
        params = {"group_type": group_type, "page_size": page_size}
        if cursor:
            params["cursor"] = cursor
        
        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params, timeout=30)
        
        if response.status_code != 200:
            raise Exception(f"获取资产列表失败: {response.text[:200]}")
        
        return response.json()
    
    # ==================== 工具方法 ====================
    
    def get_models(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        获取可用模型列表
        
        Returns:
            模型列表
        """
        url = f"{self.base_url}/models"
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        
        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=30)
        if response.status_code != 200:
            raise Exception(f"获取模型列表失败: {response.text[:200]}")
        
        return response.json().get('data', [])
    
    def get_model_info(self, model_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """获取单个模型详细信息"""
        url = f"{self.base_url}/models/{model_id}"
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        
        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=30)
        if response.status_code != 200:
            raise Exception(f"获取模型信息失败: {response.text[:200]}")
        
        return response.json()
    
    def get_usage(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """获取使用量信息"""
        url = f"{self.base_url}/dashboard/billing/usage"
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        
        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=30)
        if response.status_code != 200:
            return {"info": "请登录 https://www.orcarouter.ai/dashboard 查看使用量"}
        
        return response.json()
    
    def get_name(self) -> str:
        return f"OrcaRouter (聊天: {self.chat_model}, 图像: {self.image_model})"
    
    def get_model(self) -> str:
        return self.chat_model


# ==================== 便捷函数 ====================

def create_orcarouter_engine(api_key: str, **kwargs) -> OrcaRouterEngine:
    """创建 OrcaRouter 引擎实例"""
    return OrcaRouterEngine(api_key=api_key, **kwargs)


def orca_chat(
    messages: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    api_key: str,
    model: str = None,
    **kwargs
) -> str:
    """便捷函数：执行 OrcaRouter Chat"""
    engine = OrcaRouterEngine(api_key=api_key)
    return engine.chat(messages, model=model, **kwargs)


def orca_image(
    prompt: str,
    api_key: str,
    model: str = None,
    size: str = "1024x1024",
    **kwargs
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """便捷函数：生成图像"""
    engine = OrcaRouterEngine(api_key=api_key)
    return engine.generate_image(prompt, model=model, size=size, **kwargs)


def orca_tts(
    input_text: str,
    api_key: str,
    output_path: str = None,
    **kwargs
) -> Union[bytes, str]:
    """便捷函数：文本转语音"""
    engine = OrcaRouterEngine(api_key=api_key)
    if output_path:
        return engine.save_tts(input_text, output_path, **kwargs)
    return engine.text_to_speech(input_text, **kwargs)

"""
Orca Router AI 多模态引擎封装 - 智能路由多个 AI 提供商的 API
支持：模型列表、Chat 对话、文生图、语音合成 (TTS)、视频生成、Seedance 资产管理
官方文档: https://docs.orcarouter.ai/api-reference/
"""
import os
import requests
import json
import time
import base64
import io
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, List, Union, Generator
from PIL import Image


class OrcaRouterEngine:
    """Orca Router 多模态智能路由引擎"""
    
    # ✅ 官方推荐的默认模型配置 (可根据实际可用模型调整)
    DEFAULT_MODELS = {
        "chat": "orcarouter/auto",                  # 自动选择最便宜且可用的聊天模型
        "chat_fast": "openai/gpt-4o-mini",
        "chat_smart": "openai/gpt-4o",
        "image": "openai/dall-e-3",                 # 或 "google/imagen-3"
        "audio": "openai/tts-1",                    # 语音合成
        "video": "kling/kling-v3-omni",             # 视频生成 (Kling)
    }
    
    # ✅ Orca Router 官方服务路由
    ROUTES = [
        "https://api.orcarouter.ai/v1",             # 主服务
    ]
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        api_key: str,
        base_url: str = None,
        chat_model: str = None,
        image_model: str = None,
        audio_model: str = None,
        video_model: str = None,
    ):
        """
        初始化 Orca Router 引擎
        Args:
            api_key: Orca Router API Key (格式: sk-orca-...)
            base_url: API 地址（如果不指定，将使用主路由）
            chat_model: 默认文本对话模型
            image_model: 默认图像生成模型
            audio_model: 默认语音合成模型
            video_model: 默认视频生成模型
        """
        self.api_key = api_key
        self.base_url = base_url or self.ROUTES[0]
        self._current_route_index = 0
        self._failed_routes = set()
        
        self.chat_model = chat_model or self.DEFAULT_MODELS["chat"]
        self.image_model = image_model or self.DEFAULT_MODELS["image"]
        self.audio_model = audio_model or self.DEFAULT_MODELS["audio"]
        self.video_model = video_model or self.DEFAULT_MODELS["video"]
        
        # 限速与重试配置
        self.last_request_time = 0
        self.min_interval = 0.2
        self.max_retries = 3
        self.retry_delay = 2
        
        if not self.api_key:
            print("⚠️ 未设置 ORCA_ROUTER_API_KEY，请从 https://orcarouter.ai 获取")
        else:
            print(f"🔍 Orca Router 引擎初始化完成")
            print(f"🔍 API 地址: {self.base_url}")
            print(f"🔍 默认模型 -> Chat: {self.chat_model}, Image: {self.image_model}, Video: {self.video_model}")

    # ==================== 核心网络与路由管理 ====================
    def _get_working_route(self) -> str:
        """获取可用的路由"""
        if self._current_route_index < len(self.ROUTES):
            route = self.ROUTES[self._current_route_index]
            if route not in self._failed_routes:
                return route
        
        for i, route in enumerate(self.ROUTES):
            if route not in self._failed_routes:
                self._current_route_index = i
                self.base_url = route
                print(f"🔄 切换到备用路由: {route}")
                return route
                
        print("⚠️ 所有路由均不可用，重置路由列表...")
        self._failed_routes.clear()
        self._current_route_index = 0
        self.base_url = self.ROUTES[0]
        return self.ROUTES[0]

    def _mark_route_failed(self, route: str):
        """标记路由为失败"""
        self._failed_routes.add(route)
        print(f"⚠️ 路由 {route} 已标记为不可用")

    def _request(
        self,
        method: str,
        endpoint: str,
        data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        timeout: int = 120,
        is_binary: bool = False,
    ) -> Union[Dict[str, Any], bytes]:
        """发送请求到 Orca Router API（带重试、限流和 502 网关错误处理）"""
        if not self.api_key:
            raise ValueError("请设置 ORCA_ROUTER_API_KEY")
            
        elapsed = time.time() - self.last_request_time
        if elapsed < self.min_interval:
            time.sleep(self.min_interval - elapsed)
            
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
        }
        if not is_binary:
            headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
            
        max_attempts = self.max_retries
        for attempt in range(max_attempts):
            route = self._get_working_route()
            url = f"{route}/{endpoint.lstrip('/')}"
            
            try:
                if method.upper() == "GET":
                    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params, timeout=timeout)
                else:
                    response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=data, timeout=timeout)
                    
                self.last_request_time = time.time()
                
                # ✅ 502 错误 - 网关错误（上游模型超时常见），重试
                if response.status_code == 502:
                    print(f"⚠️ 路由 {route} 返回 502 (Bad Gateway)，上游可能超时，{self.retry_delay}s 后重试...")
                    time.sleep(self.retry_delay)
                    continue
                    
                # ✅ 429 错误 - 限流，指数退避
                if response.status_code == 429:
                    wait_time = self.retry_delay * (2 ** attempt)
                    print(f"⚠️ 请求限流 (429)，等待 {wait_time}s 后重试...")
                    time.sleep(wait_time)
                    continue
                    
                if response.status_code not in (200, 201):
                    error_detail = {}
                    try:
                        error_detail = response.json()
                    except:
                        pass
                    
                    if 'error' in error_detail:
                        error_msg = error_detail['error'].get('message', str(error_detail))
                        error_code = error_detail['error'].get('code', 'unknown')
                    else:
                        error_msg = response.text[:200]
                        error_code = response.status_code
                        
                    raise Exception(f"Orca Router API 调用失败 (状态码 {response.status_code}, 代码 {error_code}): {error_msg}")
                    
                return response.content if is_binary else response.json()
                
            except requests.exceptions.ConnectionError:
                print(f"⚠️ 路由 {route} 连接失败，尝试重试...")
                self._mark_route_failed(route)
                time.sleep(self.retry_delay)
                continue
            except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
                print(f"⚠️ 路由 {route} 超时，尝试重试...")
                self._mark_route_failed(route)
                time.sleep(self.retry_delay)
                continue
            except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
                if attempt == max_attempts - 1:
                    raise Exception(f"Orca Router 请求失败: {e}")
                print(f"⚠️ 请求异常 (尝试 {attempt+1}/{max_attempts}): {e}")
                time.sleep(self.retry_delay)
                continue
                
        raise Exception("Orca Router 所有重试均失败，请稍后重试")

    # ==================== 1. 模型管理 ====================
    def list_models(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """获取所有可用的模型列表"""
        print("🔍 获取 Orca Router 可用模型列表...")
        result = self._request("GET", "models")
        if result.get("object") == "list" and "data" in result:
            print(f"✅ 成功获取 {len(result['data'])} 个模型")
            return result["data"]
        return []

    # ==================== 2. 推理/对话 (Chat) ====================
    def chat(
        self,
        messages: List[Dict[str, Any]],
        model: str = None,
        temperature: float = 0.7,
        max_tokens: int = None,
        stream: bool = False,
        tools: List[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Union[str, Generator[str, None, None]]:
        """
        推理/对话
        """
        model = model or self.chat_model
        data = {
            "model": model,
            "messages": messages,
            "temperature": temperature,
            "stream": stream,
        }
        if max_tokens:
            data["max_tokens"] = max_tokens
        if tools:
            data["tools"] = tools
            
        data = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if v is not None}
        print(f"🔍 Orca Router 推理/对话 | 模型: {model}")
        
        if stream:
            return self._chat_stream(data)
        else:
            result = self._request("POST", "chat/completions", data)
            if 'choices' in result and len(result['choices']) > 0:
                return result['choices'][0].get('message', {}).get('content', '')
            raise Exception(f"无法解析推理结果: {json.dumps(result)[:300]}")

    def _chat_stream(self, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Generator[str, None, None]:
        """流式对话处理"""
        data["stream_options"] = {"include_usage": True}
        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
        url = f"{self.base_url}/chat/completions"
        
        response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=data, stream=True, timeout=120)
        if response.status_code != 200:
            raise Exception(f"流式推理失败: {response.text}")
            
        for line in response.iter_lines():
            if line:
                line = line.decode('utf-8')
                if line.startswith('data: '):
                    line = line[6:]
                    if line == '[DONE]':
                        print()
                        break
                    try:
                        chunk = json.loads(line)
                        if 'usage' in chunk and chunk['usage']:
                            print(f"\n📊 [Stream End] Tokens: {chunk['usage'].get('total_tokens')}")
                            continue
                        if 'choices' in chunk and len(chunk['choices']) > 0:
                            content = chunk['choices'][0].get('delta', {}).get('content', '')
                            if content:
                                print(content, end='', flush=True)
                                yield content
                    except json.JSONDecodeError:
                        pass

    def chat_simple(self, prompt: str, system_prompt: str = None, model: str = None) -> str:
        """简化版推理"""
        messages = []
        if system_prompt:
            messages.append({"role": "system", "content": system_prompt})
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})
        return self.chat(messages, model=model)

    # ==================== 3. 图像生成 (Image) ====================
    def text_to_image(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str = None,
        size: str = "1024x1024",
        quality: str = "standard",
        n: int = 1,
        response_format: str = "url",
    ) -> Union[Image.Image, str]:
        """
        文生图
        Args:
            response_format: "url" 返回 PIL Image, "b64_json" 返回 base64 字符串
        """
        model = model or self.image_model
        data = {
            "model": model,
            "prompt": prompt,
            "n": n,
            "size": size,
            "quality": quality,
            "response_format": response_format,
        }
        print(f"🔍 Orca Router 文生图 | 模型: {model}, 尺寸: {size}")
        result = self._request("POST", "images/generations", data)
        
        if 'data' in result and len(result['data']) > 0:
            item = result['data'][0]
            if response_format == "url" and 'url' in item:
                return self._download_image(item['url'])
            elif response_format == "b64_json" and 'b64_json' in item:
                return item['b64_json']
                
        raise Exception(f"无法解析图片结果: {json.dumps(result)[:300]}")

    def _download_image(self, image_url: str) -> Image.Image:
        """下载图片并返回 PIL Image"""
        if image_url.startswith("data:image"):
            base64_data = image_url.split(",", 1)[1]
            image_bytes = base64.b64decode(base64_data)
            return Image.open(io.BytesIO(image_bytes))
        
        img_response = requests.get(image_url, timeout=30)
        if img_response.status_code != 200:
            raise Exception(f"下载图片失败: {img_response.status_code}")
        return Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_response.content))

    # ==================== 4. 语音合成 (Audio TTS) ====================
    def generate_speech(
        self,
        input_text: str,
        model: str = None,
        voice: str = "alloy",
        speed: float = 1.0,
        response_format: str = "mp3",
        save_path: str = None,
    ) -> bytes:
        """
        生成语音 (TTS)
        Args:
            input_text: 要合成的文本
            voice: 音色 (alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer)
            speed: 语速 (0.25 - 4.0)
            response_format: mp3, opus, aac, flac, wav, pcm
            save_path: 如果提供，则将音频保存到该路径
        Returns:
            音频文件的二进制字节流
        """
        model = model or self.audio_model
        data = {
            "model": model,
            "input": input_text,
            "voice": voice,
            "speed": max(0.25, min(4.0, speed)),
            "response_format": response_format,
        }
        print(f"🔍 Orca Router 语音合成 | 模型: {model}, 音色: {voice}")
        audio_bytes = self._request("POST", "audio/speech", data, is_binary=True)
        
        if save_path:
            with open(save_path, "wb") as f:
                f.write(audio_bytes)
            print(f"✅ 音频已保存至: {save_path}")
            
        return audio_bytes

    # ==================== 5. 视频生成 (Video) ====================
    def submit_video_task(
        self,
        prompt: str,
        model: str = None,
        image: Union[str, Image.Image] = None,  # URL 或 PIL Image (图生视频)
        duration: int = 5,
        aspect_ratio: str = "16:9",
        mode: str = "std",  # std (720P), pro (1080P), 4k
        **metadata_kwargs,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        提交视频生成任务 (异步)
        支持 Kling 等模型。返回包含 task_id 的字典。
        """
        model = model or self.video_model
        data = {
            "model": model,
            "prompt": prompt,
            "metadata": {
                "duration": str(duration),
                "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio,
                "mode": mode,
                **metadata_kwargs
            }
        }
        
        # 处理参考图 (图生视频)
        if image is not None:
            if isinstance(image, Image.Image):
                data["image"] = f"data:image/png;base64,{self._image_to_base64(image)}"
            else:
                data["image"] = image  # 假设是 URL
                
        print(f"🔍 Orca Router 提交视频任务 | 模型: {model}, 时长: {duration}s")
        result = self._request("POST", "video/generations", data, timeout=300)
        
        if "task_id" in result or "id" in result:
            task_id = result.get("task_id") or result.get("id")
            print(f"✅ 视频任务已提交 | Task ID: {task_id}")
            return result
            
        raise Exception(f"提交视频任务失败: {json.dumps(result)[:300]}")

    def get_video_status(self, task_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """查询视频生成任务状态"""
        # Orca Router 视频状态查询通常复用原 endpoint 加 task_id，或特定 status endpoint
        # 根据 OpenAI 兼容规范，通常是 GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}
        print(f"🔍 查询视频状态 | Task ID: {task_id}")
        result = self._request("GET", f"video/generations/{task_id}")
        return result

    def wait_for_video(self, task_id: str, max_wait: int = 600, poll_interval: int = 10) -> str:
        """
        阻塞等待视频生成完成，返回视频 URL
        """
        start_time = time.time()
        last_progress = -1
        
        while time.time() - start_time < max_wait:
            try:
                status = self.get_video_status(task_id)
                state = status.get('status', '').lower()
                progress = status.get('progress', 0)
                
                if progress != last_progress:
                    print(f"⏳ 视频生成进度: {progress}% | 状态: {state}")
                    last_progress = progress
                    
                if state in ('completed', 'succeeded', 'success'):
                    video_url = status.get('video_url') or status.get('url')
                    if video_url:
                        print(f"✅ 视频生成完成!")
                        return video_url
                    time.sleep(poll_interval)
                    continue
                    
                if state in ('failed', 'error'):
                    error = status.get('error', '未知错误')
                    raise Exception(f"视频生成失败: {error}")
                    
                time.sleep(poll_interval)
                
            except Exception as e:
                if "429" in str(e) or "rate limit" in str(e).lower():
                    print(f"⚠️ 状态查询限流，等待 15 秒后重试...")
                    time.sleep(15)
                    continue
                raise
                
        raise Exception(f"视频生成超时 ({max_wait}s)")

    # ==================== 6. Seedance 资产管理 ====================
    def list_asset_groups(
        self,
        group_type: str = "real_human",  # "aigc" or "real_human"
        page_number: int = 1,
        page_size: int = 10,
        name: str = None,
        sort_by: str = "CreateTime",
        sort_order: str = "Desc",
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        列出 Seedance 资产组 (如数字人资产)
        """
        params = {
            "group_type": group_type,
            "page_number": page_number,
            "page_size": page_size,
            "sort_by": sort_by,
            "sort_order": sort_order,
        }
        if name:
            params["name"] = name
            
        print(f"🔍 查询 Seedance 资产组 | 类型: {group_type}")
        return self._request("GET", "asset/groups", params=params)

    # ==================== 工具方法 ====================
    def _image_to_base64(self, image: Image.Image) -> str:
        """将 PIL Image 转为 base64 字符串 (不含 data:image/png;base64, 前缀)"""
        buffered = io.BytesIO()
        image.save(buffered, format="PNG")
        return base64.b64encode(buffered.getvalue()).decode('utf-8')

    def get_name(self) -> str:
        return f"Orca Router Engine (Chat: {self.chat_model}, Video: {self.video_model})"
